phase_name: Surface the never-heartbeated fingerprint as a distinct diagnostic

objectives.description: Grep every consumer of cmd_check's stdout/exit codes and confirm no exact whole-line match
Extend cmd_check's held-fresh/held-stale lines with never_heartbeated= field
Extend cmd_reap's would-reap/reaped/SKIP lines with same field
Document fingerprint in task-lock.sh header and task-lock.md

consumer_survey: agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/reconcile-task-status.sh -- captures $lock_check_output as an opaque string for logging and gates on task-lock.sh check's EXIT CODE only (0/1/2/3); never does whole-line equality.
agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/orchestrate-dry-run-report.sh -- captures $lock_out similarly, interpolates into note strings, gates on exit code; never does whole-line equality.
manual_smoke_evidence: A freshly acquired lock with equal acquired_at/heartbeat_at (backdated fixture) reports never_heartbeated=true on a held-stale check line.
After one heartbeat call the same lock reports never_heartbeated=false on a held-fresh check line.
reap --dry-run on a never-heartbeated stale+dead-pid lock reports never_heartbeated=true on its 'would reap:' line.
